result.title: CUBE: Class-conditioned Unknown Boundary Evidence for Open-Set Insect Species Recognition
result.summary: Open-set insect species recognition faces significant challenges when deployed in real-world biodiversity scenarios, particularly when encountering unknown species that are visually close to known training classes. Unlike generic out-of-distribution samples, fine-grained unknown insects are often not visually anomalous. They instead tend to appear near the decision boundary of specific known species, leading to unreliable closed-set predictions. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{Class-conditioned Unknown Boundary Evidence (CUBE)}, a novel evidence-based framework that models unknownness around each known species rather than as a single global unknown class. Our key idea is to evaluate a test sample relative to the known species it most closely resembles, enabling local rejection for visually confusable unknown insects. CUBE learns class-conditioned boundary evidence from auxiliary species, preserves auxiliary species as shadow references during inference, and incorporates taxonomic candidate calibration to verify biological plausibility. When ecological metadata is available, we further introduce CUBE-E, which adds a lightweight location-consistency term without modifying the visual backbone. Experiments on the Open-Insect C-America benchmark show that CUBE achieves superior performance, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines with 95.8\%, 98.7\%, and 99.1\% AUROC on local, non-local, and non-moth unknown splits, respectively, while maintaining 94.9\% closed-set accuracy. With ecological metadata, CUBE-E further improves the results to 96.0\%, 99.7\%, and 99.5\% AUROC with 95.2\% closed-set accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CUBE，用「以已知类为条件的未知性边界证据」在细粒度昆虫物种识别中做开放集拒绝：相对最相似的已知物种评估样本、保留辅助物种作「影子参照」，并加入分类学候选校准，可选地引入地点一致性项。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文的核心是「类条件证据 + 局部拒绝 + 保留参照」的判定机制，可能为 LVR 中的多假设视觉证据筛选、候选验证与停止决策提供概念线索，但其场景是细粒度开放集分类、未涉及 latent 推理状态，需进一步核查可迁移性。
